notes.title: Update 0.6 is here! Nightmare Difficulties, Relics, New Curse System and more!
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]

[b]Nightmare Difficulty 1-3[/b]

The Nightmare Difficulties add a new challenging layer to the gameplay. They increase enemy stats and add special mods to the game. The difficulties can be unlocked by beating the previous difficulty with any hero.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/c941cb70e1ef8bd153dfefaa20aead518fd9cc51.png[/img]

[b]New Relic system [/b]

Once per depth, a new NPC will appear to deliver a random relic to you.
Relics trigger their effects at a certain rate and can be upgraded up to three times via perks!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/e931b78d1145dd5a12d3e81f3c3b5e8c1e2d25ee.png[/img]

[b]Dash recovery and Ultimate recovery seperated[/b]

Instead of using Stamina for both dashes and ultimates, the systems are now seperated. Each hero has its own amount of maximum dashes. The User Interface indicates how many dashes are recovered.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/1e554613b99aa175259abbc902aa571834cd1452.png[/img]

[b]Curse rework[/b]

Curses from items now have a timer but can be more dangerous. This way, I combined the challenge shrines (some people remember) with chests. The default curse duration is 30 seconds. Every additional Nightmare Difficulty adds 10 seconds to the base duration.
There are some new and reworked curses in the pool.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/94197dd1484c54bed8e1a00a6fa84cf50e23795f.png[/img]

[b]Expanded Blood Ritual[/b]

I expanded the Blood Ritual to a total of 111 nodes.
Newly added nodes are:
[list][*] Relic cooldown reduction
[*] Yellow butterflies will also increase your Relic cooldown reduction.
[*] Relics will be delivered earlier.
[*] Double the invulnerability duration after taking damage.[/list]

I also changed one underperforming node to:
[list][*] At the end of a run, convert excess gold to Blood Rubies at a ratio of 50:1.[/list]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/79b4542d15a6a7695677976ffe04a1d2bf13cc02.png[/img]

[b]New Blood Ruby reward panel[/b]

Instead of rewarding Blood Rubies only for kills at the end of the run, there are new ways to gain them. Here is an example:

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/8f57b31559ed77f6650840b3f631395acb1f6d7a.png[/img]

[b]Localization: Chinese[/b]

I added support for different languages and started with Chinese as the first localization.
More languages will be supported very soon.

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]

[list][*]Temporarily disabled the save function for runs because of several issues
[*]Rebalanced enemy hp and movement speed depth scaling
[*]Dashing towards movement direction is now standard. Added an Option so you can dash towards the mouse position
[*]Kaito became the "Bomb Specialist". Bombs are his default projectile now.
[*]The projectile damage of Mothman can now be modified by projectile min and max damage mods
[*]Buffed the projectile range and damage of Aric
[*]Buffed the projectile damage of Misty and Gundel
[*]Bosses are not repositioning anymore when you move around the map
[*]More Performance improvements
[*]Changed all +max hp stats to +1
[*]Added a visual effect for curse activation
[*]Added a visual effect for dashes
[*]Added a visual effect for Ice Orbs aoe freeze
[*]Added Blood Rubies to the drop pool of common enemies
[*]New boss mod: Earthsplitter
[*]Removed boss mod : Dash to kill
[*]Explosion on dash now deals 500 instead of 100 damage
[*]Curse damage now starts with 5 instead of 1, and increments by 10 instead of 5
[*Doubled the default frost damage multiplier
[*]Changed the Blood Ritual node "-2% enemy projectile speed" to "-2% enemy projectile distance"
[*]Flying heroes are now immune to ground effects like ground aoe and bombs
[*]Added icons for buff effects from butterflies
[*]Added visual effect for dash effects from perks
[*]Reduced the base chance of rare drops for bosses
[*]New achievements: Nightmare I, Nightmare II, Nightmare III, The Void , What Could Go Wrong?[/list]

[h2]Perks[/h2]

[b]New perks[/b]

[list][*]Adrenaline Rush: +5% Relic cooldown reduction
[*]Persistent: +5% Dash cooldown reduction
[*]Low End: +5 projectile min damage
[*]High End: +10 projectile max damage
[*]Treasure Hunter I: Doubles the drop chance for rare items from bosses.
[*]Treasure Hunter II: Bosses drop a cluster of experience.
[*]Treasure Hunter III: Doubles the amount of experience dropped by bosses.
[*]Repulsion I: Splash damage deals 25% more damage.
[*]Repulsion II: Splash damage deals 50% more damage.
[*]Repulsion III: Splash damage deals 75% more damage.
[*]Repulsion IV: Your critical strikes always cause splash damage.[/list]

[b]Changes to perks[/b]

[list][*] Trigger Point I: Automatically trigger your Ultimate when it's ready. +10% Ultimate recovery
[*] Trigger Point II: +20% Ultimate recovery
[*] Ready To Strike: +20% crit chance while all dashes are recovered
[*] Ready To Strike+: 10% dash recovery instead of Stamina recovery
[*] Adrenaline Surge: 1% chance to recover your Ultimate when you deal a critical strike.
[*] Snipers Gambit: You can't deal critical strikes against bosses.
[*] Concentration III : Health potions don't recover health but grant xp.
[*] Culling Strike: Changed the threshold from 20% to 10%
[*] Rampage: 20% increased damage while walking (from 50%)
[*] Reduced the evasion values of some perks[/list]


[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list][*] Fixed curse removal gamepad
[*] Fixed the activation of perks from the Blood Shop[/list]

notes.title: What to expect from 0.6
notes.content:
[b]Relics[/b]

Relics are powerful items that trigger powerful effects. Each relic has its own timer and can be upgraded up to three times. You can find one per depth. Check the screenshot below to see a preview of the UI integration.

[b]Stamina rework[/b]

I seperated the cooldowns for the Ultimate and Dash. In the screenshot below you can see the new Dash recovery bar, including the indicators. Different heroes start with a different amount of Dashes. There will be two new perks that increase the recovery rates.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/4b898bce05e7111e4d278f926b41fc187ef36894.png[/img]

[b]Curse rework[/b]

Curses from items now have a duration, 30 seconds on default with an increased duration for each Nightmare difficulty.
The update adds six new curses and adjusts old curses for the new system.
This way, curses can be more dangerous and interesting - while adding the flair of the challenge shrines I has in the game a while ago!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/e55740f62a376b11fbcda244b64250fd3c163717.png[/img]

[b]Nightmare Difficulties[/b]

0.6 will introduce Nightmare 1-3. Every tier increases enemy health, enemy speed, enemy projectile speed, enemy projectile distance and the curse duration. Each tier adds a special mod as well.
Beating Nightmare 5 will unlock the Endless Mode in the near future! :)

[b]Localization[/b]

I integrated the support for different languages and started with Chinese!
The next languages will most likely be Spanish, Portugese, French and German.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/aaa4a769d4db7f8b00a1af93bc22e3068fc276da.png[/img]

[b]Other stuff[/b]

I also added a few new visual effects for different things, new sound effects, more performance improvements and QoL. For example, I added an option to change the dash direction towards the mouse position. The default direction is now the movement direction.

Some downsides of perks have been nerfed as well, here are some examples:
[b]Snipers Gambit[/b]: You can't deal critical strikes against bosses. (Instead of no crits at all)
[b]Concentration III[/b] : Health potions don't recover health but grant xp. (Instead of health potions hurt you)


I'm really hyped for the release of this update! Alpha testing will start this week so I think I can release 0.6 next monday!
Are you interested in alphatesting or giving me some ideas for other new relics? Join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/2vHmDz7B9S]Discord[/url]

Cheers
inbyo

notes.title: v0.4 is live - MASSIVE update! Let's go!
notes.content:
[b]Power Fantasy[/b] didn't see an update for a long time - but it's back better than ever! The game is getting closer to where I want it to be. There are too many changes to list them all, but here are the major ones:

[h2]NEW DEPTH SYSTEM[/h2]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/13133ccefaa786b6dd26e7ef933cdbb9b425ff62.png[/img]

Instead of selecting a single map for a hero, you now progress through four depths. The difficulty scales with the depth.
After surviving for 5 minutes, a map boss will appear. Defeat it to get access to a rift that takes you to the next depth.
This way, there is more room for build progression, better enemy scaling and meaningful meta upgrades. How far can you push your heroes?

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/369e6aad38ce54c7f313514751af9f2a395987ba.png[/img]

[h2]META PROGRESSION OVERHAUL[/h2]

Instead of being tied to hard achievements, Blood Rubies are now being rewarded after each run - based on the amount of enemies you killed. They can also drop from minibosses.
Since you keep getting Blood Rubies after completing the Blood Ritual, you can now use them to purchase companions before you start a new run. I'm going to add more things to purchase in the near future (Stat boosts and Nightmare modifiers to customize your endgame).

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/2d951422d2e5bda65ab0890e3afe63218098583c.png[/img]

[h2]REFINED PERK SYSTEM[/h2]

The perk system got some big improvements. It's more stable and the weighting of the different rarities got some tweaks.
I also added a lot of new interesting perks, perk chains and synergies to allow more build variety. I will add even more perks with the next update.
One legendary perk will appear about every 20 levels. I limited the access but made legendary perks and their synergies more impactful.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/9c3a65d9e601d20d6febbb10f019934de06fb55b.png[/img]

[h2]ULTIMATE[/h2]

I replaced the Dash with a new Ultimate mechanic. When your Ultimate is getting triggered, you knock back enemies around you and destroy all projectiles on the screen. There are perks and meta upgrades that modify the Ultimate recovery speed.

[h2]POLISH[/h2]

notes.title: v0.3 is live! The biggest update yet!
notes.content:
[h2]NEW MAPS[/h2]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/3721a497a10de8de64362354216f09e0bd23c830.png[/img]

The new maps replace the old Nightmare difficulties and introduce a new level of enemy variety. There are four core maps:

[olist][*] Corrupted Forest: Survive for 12 minutes.
[*] Orc Kingdom: Survive for 13 minutes.
[*] Forgotten Crypt: Survive for 13 minutes.
[*] Hell: Reach level 50 to summon the Balrog and defeat it.[/olist]
Your Nightmare progress will be converted to the new system.

[h2]BLOOD RITUAL[/h2]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/225ddaa9b05a68af9b109ce22c60e6c69b878b0e.png[/img]

The second layer of meta progression is here! Some achievements reward you with blood rubies which can be specced into the Blood Ritual skill tree. Maxing two adjacent nodes will unlock a higher node. Those nodes will help you progress towards higher maps. Respeccing is free.

[h2]AUTO ATTACK & AUTO AIM[/h2]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/52YKj40P/2024-06-17-20-41-21-1.gif[/img]

A lot of players requested this feature: It's now possible to toggle autoattack with a completely new autoaim mechanic! In addition, I completely removed the movement speed penalty when you attack!

[h2]DASH & RELICS[/h2]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/CLQmyR0v/2024-06-17-20-50-48-1.gif[/img]

Another new gameplay mechanic is the dash: RMB/RT will make your hero dash. Once your stamina regenerated, you can dash again. There are different ways to increase your stamina recovery speed.
During your run, you will encounter new sparkly chests with relics. Relics enhance your dash skill with interesting modifiers. Dashing with multiple relics stacked will trigger multiple effects at once.

[h2]UI OVERHAUL[/h2]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/1b24e99528c39d6ec511d318cad68611f93fa2da.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/1d2e00c9d56bf926001affd04f40431497446757.png[/img]

[h2]NEW HEROES[/h2]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/d3b881cc83a7854473a08c4a937cbe1a78c60025.png[/img]
[b]Mad, the Inventor[/b]
Type: Lightning

[list][*] 20% chance to create a Storm Strike at the closest enemy when you attack.
[*] Start with Book of Ice and Scroll of Fire.
[*] Convert burn to freeze. Convert freeze to burn.[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/8cb825d9292ac5e903ed8f7ea7079e8021270345.png[/img]

Type: Curse

Mothman introduces a whole new damage type: Curse!
Heroes with this type curse enemies in an area around them while their projectiles deal no impact damage. Min and max projectile damage modifiers get converted to damage multiplier.

[list][*] 20% chance to fear enemies on hit.
[*] +5% evasion and +10% curse tick rate for every item curse on you.[/list]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list][*]All damage modifiers are now global: They affect projectile damage, burn damage, frost damage and companion damage!
[*]This way, different damage types and dots will also be affected by conditional modifiers from perks like Rampage and Daredevil.
[*]Added 6 new perks
[*]New options: You can now change the volume of music and effects seperately and disable the aim line.[/list]

[list][*]Massively increased the attack and movement speed of Effy
[*]Increased the range of Effy
[*]Effy trait change: Frost damage is being dealt twice: When the freeze starts and ends.
[*]Doubled the rate of Effys projectile aoe freeze
[*]Increased Icicles base attack speed by 50%
[*]Icicle trait change: +10 pierce. Additional pierce mods gives +10% chance for +2 projectiles
[*]Icicles arrows are now thicker
[*]Reduced the amount of gold needed to trigger the perk Gold Rush from 200 to 50
[*]Butterflies now despawn after 60 seconds
[*]Slightly changed the attack animation of Ember
[*]Added a new "Damage" tag for perks that have global damage modifiers
[*]Renamed "max damage" and "min damage" to "max projectile damage" and "min projectile damage"
[*]The traveling merchant now comes a little bit closer to you
[*]Projectile, Burn and frost damage shown in the stat panel are now already scaled values
[*]Health potions from the merchant now give XP when you already are at full life
[*]Increased the range of Aric from 3.5 to 4
[*]Increased the base burn damage from 2 to 3
[*]Increased the default damage of Misty
[*]Increased crit chance of Ember and Gundel to 15%
[*]Added new attack sounds for Zikk and Gundel
[*]Item chests can no longer drop when the pool is depleted
[*]Curse damage can now crit
[*]Bosses can be frozen for a longer duration now
[*]Voltage Vortex has a much higher radius
[*]Removed the item suffix "Can't walk while attacking"
[*]Buffed the effect of the slow aura
[*]Updated Darias traits to be less confusing
[*]Misty doesn't take collision damage while on the broom anymore (She is flying)
[*]The center perk is now automatically selected when the perk panel opens[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list][*] Unaffordable items can no longer be purchased from the merchant
[*] Challenge shrines can no longer spawn inside obstacles[/list]

notes.title: COLLECTION! PHYSICAL & HELL REVAMP! NEW DLC HERO! - Update v0.21
notes.content:
0.21 comes with QoL and performance improvements, balancing, tweaks and more content. I enhanced the new player experience by improving the starter hero Aric and improved the fire and physical type mechanics so they are more fun. All the heroes move faster now. You can now see a list of all perks and item affixes available to better plan your builds. The new DLC hero supports the development and future of the game - Thank you for all the support.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2856540/

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]

[list][*]We now have a collection, accessible from the main menu: See a neat overview of perks and items affixes before your run!
[*]Major performance improvements
[*]Polished level selection: The level selection now provides additional information about the selected level. It is now possible to progress difficulties on other maps than Dark Abyss!
[*]The pause screen now shows the level name and difficulty.
[*]New perk: Gold Rush (+20% attack speed and +20% movement speed when you have over 200 gold)
[*]New perk: Focused Force (+50% projectile damage, -10% area of effect)
[*]New perk: Brawlers Fury (+15% area of effect, +5% crit chance)
[*]Visual aoe indicator for all the auras[/list]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/afe1df97ec605eb856daa985b620b818b8987aa6.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/6f21a51f11bc8e93cc3cd633c32a307589c1cb45.png[/img]

[h2]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]

[list][*] Overwhelmed: Die by the Hell-o-Meter reaching its maximum.
[*] Hell Rider: Reach Hell-level 50.
[*] Lost Opportunity (Die with at least 10 remaining rerolls)
[*] Kaze Survivor: Survive with Kaze (Normal difficulty)
[*] Kaze Surviror (Nightmare 5): Survive with Kaze (Nightmare 5 difficulty)
[*] Spoilsport: (DLC) In Krampus Night, destroy an evil snowman during the challenge Snowball Fight.[/list]

[h2]HELL REVAMP[/h2]

[list][*]When you enter the portal, you start a second layer of progression: Hell-levels! A second level will appear, starting from 1. Loot hellish xp to get hellish perks. There are 8 stackable hell perks now!
[*]The darkness radius will now change once the Hell-o-Meter is over 50%
[*]New and more enemies!
[*]Added a short explanation to the Hell-o-Meter when you enter Hell[/list]

[h2]PHYSICAL TYPE REWORK[/h2]

[list][*]Completely removed the knockback mechanic
[*]The physical type now has a 50% chance to deal splash damage on default
[*]Splash damage deals 50% of your projectile damage to close enemies when a projectile hits an enemy. The area scales with aoe modifiers and has a visual effect
[*]Splash damage only works with a projectiles first impact and pierce
[*] Adjusted perks:
[*] [b]Intimidating[/b]: +5% chance to deal splash damage on hit. +20% projectile damage.
[*] [b]Repulsion[/b]: +5% chance to deal splash damage on hit. Splash damage deals 10% more damage.
[*] [b]Strong Opinion[/b]: +5% chance to deal splash damage on hit. +20% crit multiplier
[*] [b]Ice Force[/b]: Splash damage has a 50% chance to freeze enemies.
[*] [b]Hexblade Strike[/b]: Dealing splash damage to a cursed enemy removes 2% of his current life.[/list]

[h2]HERO CHANGES[/h2]

[b]Aric[/b]
[list][*] Damage increased from 15-20 to 15-30
[*] Crit chance increased from 20% to 25%
[*] Increased the base attack speed
[*] New traits:
[*] 1% chance to heal 1 hp when you slay an enemy.
[*] Perform a battle cry when you take damage, damaging and knocking back nearby enemies.[/list]

[b]Daria[/b]
[list][*]Daria now has a new attack pattern
[*] Increased the base damage from 3-9 to 12-22 
[*] Reduced the base projectile range from 12 to 5
[*] Reduced the base projectile speed from 10 to 8
[*] Polished traits:
[*]+4 frontal projectiles.
[*] Buff your companions damage by 300% while you attack.
[*] Your projectiles deal 50% less damage while walking.[/list]

[b]Misty[/b]
[list][*] Increased the movement speed from 3.5 to 4
[*] Reduced the base projectile range from 9 to 7[/list]

[b]Santa[/b]
[list][*] Increased the movement speed from 2.5 to 3.8[/list]

[b]Gundel[/b]
[list][*]The ground effect now lasts longer and causes less visual clutter[/list]

[b]Kaito[/b]
[list][*]Increased the base projectile range from 3 to 5
[*]Changes the base projectile spread from 30 to 50[/list]

[b]Icicle[/b]
[list][*] Reduced the base projectile range from 11 to 8[/list]

[b]Zikk[/b]
[list][*] Reduced the base projectile range from 6 to 4[/list]

[b]Effy[/b]
[list][*]New additional trait: Frost damage is being dealt when the freeze starts instead of when it expires.[/list]

[h2]TWEAKS[/h2]

[list][*]Challenge shrines now spawn like they did before - they spawn randomly on the map once their time has come. I adjusted the required unlocks for the challenges.
[*]Added drop sounds to books & potions
[*]Reduced the time between burns from 0.3s to 0.175s and made burn damage apply sooner so burn spread is working even if the enemy gets killed by projectile damage
[*] (You will see much more burn and burn spread now. Non-fire heroes can utilize the Scroll of Fire better now.)
[*]Drastically improved the attack pattern of the Phoenix companion (now shoots several projectiles towards the closest enemy from time to time, dealing a burn explosion on impact)
[*]Increased the attack speed of the Cactus companion
[*]Slightly reduced the drop rate of perks
[*]Increased the overall number of archers
[*]Changed the overall aesthetic of Krampus Night (darker and more "corrupted")
[*]Krampus Night is now 10 minutes long and has a higher xp rate
[*]Reduced the freeze duration for bosses and minibosses
[*]Updated the description for Blades of Justice+
[*] [b]Alactrity[/b]: Reduced the attack speed from 25% to 15%
[*] [b]Accelerator: [/b] Reduced the attack speed from 10% to 5%
[*] [b]Bloodlust:[/b] Now gives 3% instead of 5% attack speed per levelup
[*] Reduced the damage increase of chaining projectiles for the Arcane type from 25% to 10%
[*] Increased the base burn spread chance for the Fire type from 20% to 30%
[*] Bosses can now attack when they are frozen
[*] Polished the visual appearance of the indicator arrow
[*] [b]Bulls Eye suffix[/b]: Reduced the increased enemy projectile speed from 75% to 30%
[*] Changed the required achievements for some of the core hero unlocks:
[*] Zikk will get unlocked with Misty N1
[*] Kaito with Zikk N1
[*] Gundel with Kaito N2
[*] Effy with Gundel N2
[*] Daria with Effy N3[/list]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]

[list][*]Fixed a visual bug that affected the health bars in Hell
[*]Fixed a bug that spawned the Mysterious Egg far away from the player location
[*]Fixed a bug that crashed your game if you took Orbit after you lost one of your companions
[*]Fixed a bug that let you purchase duplicate companions
[*]Fixed a problem that caused the banish buttons to be invisible on some resolutions
[*]Fixed a problem with the menu background on some resolutions

This update adds a new layer to build customization: The undead merchant.
He will appear every three minutes. Collect coins and go shopping for insane build opportunities!
I also rebalanced Nightmare and buffed some heroes to create a less frustrating experience.
Challenges now spawn differently. The first boss will spawn the first shrine from N1 upwards, the second boss will spawn the second shrine from N2 upwards etc. They don't pause the spawns anymore, by removing the arena I want to provide a more exciting challenge.
So there will be 5 challenges to beat in N5 in the near future. Beating all of them in one run will trigger something endgame related.
The new synergies are just the beginning. The focus was fire, ice, arcane and blades. The next updates will add more synergies between the different elements.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/d41dfa2f35a4bbb35d35935aba9e7754713d1737.png[/img]

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[b]NEW: Undead Merchant & Coin drops[/b]
The undead merchant will appear every 3 minutes, offering the following items:
[list]
[*] Health Potions
[*] Spirit Potions
[*] Sweet Tonic: +2 min damage
[*] Bitter Tonic +3 max damage
[*] Salty Tonic: -5% enemy projectile speed
[*] Perks
[*] Dispelled items
[*] Companions
[/list]
There are two new unlocks that will improve the merchant!

[h2]NEW PERKS[/h2]

[list][*] [b]Hard Bargain[/b]: 30% off at the Undead Merchant
[*] [b]Penny Pincher[/b]: +15% coin drops
[*] [b]Voltage Vortex[/b]: Regularly hurt close enemies. Deals half of your max damage as lightning damage. (Lightning Aura)
[*] [b]Lucky Shots[/b]: +3% crit chance, +10% crit multiplier
[*] [b]Nimble[/b]: +7% movement speed, +5% attack speed
[*] [b]Quick Wits[/b]: 4% attack speed, 8% xp multiplier
[*] [b]Projectile Ballet[/b]: +4% evasion, +6% projectile damage
[*] [b]Bolt Blitz[/b]: +15% projectile damage, +5% movement speed
[*] Synergy "[b]Frostfire Fusion[/b]": Freezing a burning enemy will cause an explosion. (Synergy Book of Ice + Scroll of Fire)
[*] [b]Whisper of Death[/b] (Challenge perk): Your projectiles curse enemies. Cursed enemies take increasing curse damage every second.
[*] [b]Hex Master[/b]: Whisper of Death ticks faster. (Synergy Whisper of Death + Tome Of Mysteries)
[*] [b]Frostburn [/b](Word Of Pain + Book Of Ice): Heal 1 hp when a frozen enemy gets killed by Word Of Pain.
[*] [b]Friendly Force[/b]: 50% companion damage
[*] [b]Hive Leader[/b]: 100% companion damage, 20% move speed
[*] [b]Monarch[/b]: 250% companion damage, +1 max health, +2 spirit hearts
[*] [b]Blades Of Judiciary[/b]: Second layer of Blades (Upgrade from Blades Of Justice)
[*] [b]Blade Master[/b]: Blades deal 300% increased damage while you don't attack (Upgrade from Blades Of Justice)
[*] [b]Flaming Blades[/b]: Blades burn enemies (Synergy Blades of Justice + Scroll Of Fire)
[*] [b]Astral Blades[/b]: Blades reflect enemy projectiles (Synergy Blades of Justice + Tome Of Mysteries)
[*] [b]Blood Money[/b]: Every 5th coin you loot will heal you. (Exclusive merchant perk)[/list]

[h2]UNLOCKS[/h2]

[list][*] Companion: Cactus. Attacks nearby enemies while you are stationary. (Kaito N2)
[*] Challenge: Armored Warrior: +50% coin drops
[*] Challenge: Apocalyptic Riders: Grants the perk "Whisper of Death"
[*] Undead Merchant I
[*] Undead Merchant II[/list]

[h2]ACHIEVEMENTS[/h2]

[list][*] Armored Warrior
[*] Mind AND Matter
[*] Golden Boy
[*] Emergency Fund
[*] Full Team
[*] Apocalyptic Riders[/list]

[h2]TWEAKS[/h2]

Improved the base movement speed of some heroes:
[list][*] Ember 2.5 -> 3.5
[*] Gundel 3 -> 3.5
[*] Aric 3.5 -> 4
[*] Zikk 3.8 -> 4
[*] Kaito 4 -> 4.5[/list]
[list][*] Increased the base damage of Kaito from 5-7 to 8-12
[*] Reduced the crit chance of Kaito from 50% to 40%
[*] Increased the base damage of Misty from 7-9 to 9-13
[*] Increased the base attack speed of Zikk by 50%
[*] Increased the base hp of Zikk from 3 to 4
[*] Increased the base hp of Misty from 2 to 3
[*] Increased the base hp of Icicle from 3 to 4
[*] Reduced the hp increase of enemies from 10% to 2% per nightmare difficulty
[*] Additional balancing to the nightmare difficulties and enemy hp
[*] Adjusted the general enemy projectile speed
[*] Rebalanced the hp of the challenge enemies
[*] Challenge enemies now have health bars
[*] Challenges don't pause the game time anymore, providing a smoother (and more challenging) experience
[*] Removed the timer from challenges
[*] Gundels ground effect now causes less screen clutter
[*] The win/death panel comes with new sound effects
[*] The value of enemies killed and damage dealt is now formatted for better readability
[*] More improvements to performance
[*] Improved the behaviour of all companions
[*] Blades of Justice and Gundels burn damage now correctly scale with perks like Daredevil and Rampage
[*] Improved the visibility of Ghosts
[*] Increased the pathfinding priority of Bosses and Mages
[*] Slightly reduced the amount and movement speed of shadow invasion enemies
[*] New modifier: Companion damage
[*] Added companion damage to the stat panel
[*] There is now a sound effect when you gain a spirit heart[/list]

[h2]FIXES[/h2]

[list][*] Fixed the movement pattern of the ice orb companion
[*] Ascended perks are now correctly displayed in the perk overview
[*] Fixed a bug with the goblin carrier being stuck in the pickup animation when you pick up a chest before him
[*] Fixes the spawns of the second wave of zombie bears
[*] Fixed the audio problem caused by picking up a lot of xp at once[/list]

notes.title: NEW HERO! NEW UNLOCKS! PERFORMANCE! DYNAMIC SPAWNS! - UPDATE V0.17
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/03e1e2a9c54be39d5b83f7e71796f77e0c330325.png[/img]

[b]New hero: Effy, the Ice Queen[/b]

[i]Effy, the Ice Queen, ruled the frozen wastelands with an icy resolve. Her secret lover, Icicle, a nomadic frostwalker, veiled her face with a mysterious cape, a silent testament to their forbidden love, as they braved a world uncertain if their paths would ever intertwine again.[/i]

Has no red hearts.
Starts with 3 spirit hearts.
Your projectile frequently freezes close enemies based on your chance to freeze.
Enemies also get frost damage when they get frozen.


[b]Improved dynamic spawn system[/b]
[list][*] Completely reworked and polished the waves
[*] Normal enemies now spawn dynamically based on how many you kill (More kills = more to kill)
[*] Added a more swarmy behaviour to the enemy waves and spawns
[*] Drastically improved the overall performance
[*] Reworked bullet patterns of mages and added them as a modifier for Nightmare 2[/list]

[b]Perk changes:[/b]
[list][*] New perk: Distant Mirror. 50% chance to reflect enemy projectile while attacking. (Arcane)
[*] Life leech now only applies to the first impact of the main frontal projectile
[*] Increased the chance for Life leech to trigger from 0.5% to 2%
[*] Removed the perk requirements for the perk Rampage
[*] Removed the boss related mods from the books and activated them by default
[*] Far Shot: Reduced projectile distance from 50% to 20%
[*] Fuzzy Illusion: Reduced projectile distance from 25% to 10%
[*] Moved Ignited Wounds to Book of Fire
[*] Attractive: Reduced pickup range from 100% to 80%
[*] Psychic: Reduced the enemy projectile slowdown from 50% to 25%
[*] Pacifist: Increased the timer from 5 to 10 seconds
[*] Daydreamer: Increased the timer from 5 to 10 seconds
[*] Corrected the description of Daredevil from "below 50% hp" to "while on low life"[/list]

[b]Ascended perks[/b] get unlocked by completing Nightmare 3 with different heroes. They will upgrade perks and add powerful modifiers:

[list][*] Blades of Justice+ (Aric N3)
[*] Elusive Grace+ (Kaito N3)
[*] Mystic Volley+ (Icicle N3)
[*] Ignited Wounds+ (Gundel N3)
[*] Concentration+ (Ember N3)
[*] Psychic+ (Misty N3)
[*] Arctic Presence+ (Effy N3)[/list]

Other Unlocks:
[list][*] Bloody Hands 1-3 (5% global projectile damage)[/list]

[b]Companions[/b]

[list][*] Companions now have their own damage type and modifier: Companion damage (Pink)
[*] New companion: Buffy. Attracts butterflies.
[*] New companion: Goblin Carrier. Opens chests for you. 50% chance to remove curses. 20% chance to die while doing so.
[*] Cloudy is now more aggressive
[*] Ice Orb now circles around the hero[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with Heat and Hotheaded not adding burn damage
[*] Fixed a bug with Concentration not getting applied immediately after activating the perk
[*] Fixed a bug with Concentration getting deactivated after getting a perk with attack speed
[*] Corrected the arrow pointing towards the blue butterfly
[*] Fixed a bug that caused butterflies to fly towards the map center
[*] Reduced the move area of butterflies
[*] Reduced the spawn range of butterflies from 14 to 10 units
[*] Added Blue Butterfly. Activates XP buff + xp vacuum
[*] Fixed the cursor again
[*] The gamepad mode will now automatically toggle when you press a button on your gamepad
[*] Fixed Gundels burn area. It applied 2 stacks of burn on first impact before, now it correctly applies 1 burn stack per second[/list]

[b]Tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the visibility of the direction arrow
[*] Companions now teleport to the player when they got left behind
[*] Changed the visual indicator for butterfly buffs
[*] Addes stats to the stat panel: burn chance, burn duration, frost damage, freeze chance, freeze duration
[*] Stat panel now shows the current aoe modifier (including temporary from concentration)
[*] Stat panel now shows the current attack speed (including temporary from concentration)
[*] Added "Always crit bosses" to the item mods
[*] Adjusted spawn rates in Krampus Night
[*] Bosses can now still attack while being frozen
[*] Polished the swarm effect of the Shadow Invasion
[*] Polished the perk upgrade preview
[*] Polished the UI for Unlockables and Achievements (Now with a scrollbar!)
[/list]

[b]New Achievements[/b]

[list][*] Slayer 2-3
[*] Entomologist: Touch a total of 300 bufferflies. Unlocks Buffy.
[*] Pacifist: Survive 3 minutes without attacking once.[/list]

[b]This update includes the latest hotfix 0.163:[/b]

[list][*] Fixed a bug with Arics knockback paired with knockback damage that made the game crash
[*] Fixed a bug that wouldn't let Zikk reach his full amount of chains
[*] All heroes now start with the book of their damage type
[*] Changed it so perk upgrades have a 30% chance to show in every slot instead of 100% in the middle slot
[*] Rerolling perks now doesn't show the same perks twice
[*] Added a dedicated mode for gamepad so each mode can be better polished
[*] Made it easier to navigate through the hero and companion selection with gamepad/Steamdeck
[*] The game now automatically selects the last played hero
[*] Removed unnecessary mods from the stat panel
[*] Perk upgrades and perk synergies now show the perks that were required
[*] The patch already includes a fraction of the achievements and unlocks that were scheduled for 0.17
[*] Fixed a bug that made heroes deal no damage after using Mystic Volley+
[*] Fixed a major performance leak[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.16 + Christmas DLC release
notes.content:
It's a big day for Power Fantasy!
I just released a big update and the first DLC: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725210/Power_Fantasy_Krampus_Night/]Krampus Night[/url], a Christmas themed content pack!
There will be a giveaway of 5 Steam keys in the Discord on Sunday,  [url=https://discord.gg/2vmMV5K5tp]join the Server[/url] if you want to get into the pool.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/a47cee7ee09e6529c79fccd8b3090bbad96ff3c3.png[/img]

[h1]UPDATE 0.16 - Patch notes[/h1]

[h2][b]FEATURES[/b][/h2]

[b]New hero: Gundel, the Firestarter[/b]
Type: Fire
Traits:
Burn the ground on projectile impact.
Burn damage scales with projectile damage modifiers.

[b]Companions[/b]
Each hero will unlock a unique companion after beating Nightmare 2. I added the first batch with 0.16. You can toggle them in the hero selection.
[list]
[*] Rolling Stone: Deals 10 physical damage on impact. (Aric)
[*] Spirit Guardian: Start your run with an additional spirit heart. (Ember)
[*] Ice Orb: +100% freeze duration (Icicle)
[*] Swamp Frog: +10% evasion (Misty)
[*] Cloudy: Hits enemies with 2 lightning damage. (Zikk)
[/list]

[b]Midgame stats[/b]
When pausing the game, leveling up or picking up an item, you can now see a neat little summary of all your stats!
You can also see details about your active perks during the run!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44359484/c96c9ecea8902d2bbf4488f29bdfbc6b37581a9d.png[/img]

[h2][b]OTHER FEATURES[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Added 19 new achievements
[*] New sound effect on damage taken
[*] New visual indicators for the book perks
[*] Added  a new enemy to wave 3: Brain Slayer
[*] New item mods and perks around additional min and max flat damage
[*] New item debuff: Your max damage is your min damage.
[*] New boss: Grim Reaper
[*] Mimics now drop an item instead of a health potion
[*] Completing a challenge will now add new enemies to the enemy pool (Experimental)
[/list]


[b]Damage rebalancing / Perk reworks:[/b]
I changed some of the book-specific perks to give them more identity but also to make them viable to every hero. Specific type related damage modifiers were converted to global projectile damage.

[b]General:[/b][list]
[*] Removed Trickshot
[*] New perks: Accelerator and Far Shot
[/list]

[b]Fire (DoT):[/b]
[list]
[*] Procentual fire damage modifiers are now flat burn damage improvements
[*] Moved the Magma ball projectile from Ember to a new perk: Magma Ball
[*] Ember has now a 30% chance to spread burns
[*] Removed all projectile damage modifiers from the fire perks, it's all about burn damage now
[*] Arsonist: Changed 100% burn damage to +2 burn damage
[*] Burned page: Added +1 burn damage
[*] New perk "Heat": +100% burn duration, +1 burn damage
[*] Hotheaded: Added +2 burn damage
[/list]

[b]Ice (Pierce):[/b][list]
[*] Moved "Penetrator" from General to Ice
[*] Chilly: Converted 20% Ice Damage to 8% Projectile Damage
[*] Glacial Shot: Converted 50% Ice Damage to +1 pierce
[/list]

[b]Arcane (Chain):[/b]
[list]
[*] Multiple Endings: +1 chain instead of +2 frontal projectiles
[*] Fuzzy Illusion: Converted 40% Arcane Damage to 10% Projectile Damage
[*] New perk: Arcane Presence (Aura): Slow enemies around you
[/list]

[b]Physical (Projectiles):[/b][list]
[*] Cascade: Moved to Manual Of Might
[*] Last Man Standing: Moved to General perks and removed the physical damage
[*] Veteran: Now saves your current xp after level up. Now also adds +1 max health
[*] Mighty Hands: Converted 80% Physical Damage to 40% Projectile Damage
[/list]
